description: This file defines the TranslationHelper class, which handles loading translation data from YAML files and interacting with the database to store translation records within the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods for adding translations, retrieving database connections, and querying translation data.

classes.name: TranslationHelper
classes.description: A utility class for managing language translations by reading YAML files and persisting data into a database, tailored for the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TranslationHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Loads translation data from a YAML file for a specified language and saves each translation to the database.

methods.name: saveTranslationRecord
methods.description: Saves a single translation record into the database, creating new entries if they do not exist.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns a helper object for language string operations.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves the database ID for a given language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance from the current database connection.

methods.name: getTranslationRecord
methods.description: Retrieves an existing translation record ID based on language string ID and language ID.
